text: Take a breath. Now take another. One of those came from algae. Not from a forest, from something you can barely see. Algae make about half the oxygen on Earth. No roots. No leaves. Just sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide. And they're fast. Some double their mass in a single day. Which is why we're turning them into fuel, food, and a way to pull carbon out of the sky. The smallest thing in the ocean, doing the biggest job.
